none: PAS PAS-594DC3: Water Newton: Roman finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

CORONER'S REPORT. Description of find. A damaged and distorted Roman silver finger-ring with very slender plain tapered hoop, narrow plain shoulders and a tiny flattened oval bezel, now dished through damage. The uneven surface of the bezel (not the remains of an inscription) may be the remains of degraded solder for a (now missing) appliqué. Date: probably 1 st -2 nd century AD. Dimensions: maximum length 23.6 mm. bezel width 5.3 mm. Weight: 2.4 g
